description: An optional profile a key publishes about itself. The key is the principal whether or not a profile exists; the profile adds claims (kind, custody, a display name). One profile per key, superseded only by that key or its successor. A successor does not re-admit a predecessor's profile: the Succession event is the record of the key change, and the successor admits its own Principal under its own key.

claims: the key that signed this admission published this profile of itself at the recorded position on the chain
the profile was superseded, if ever, only by that key or by its recorded successor
doesNotClaim: that the custody declaration is true beyond the key's own word — a runtime holding a key can be compromised and an operator owning the runtime can read it; this sentence is printed wherever custody is printed
that the recorded actor is any particular person, organization, or agent beyond the key that signed — a name is a claim; a key id is the identity
that a display name is unique, or is anyone's legal name
